hindi_medium.name: Hindi-medium content missing
hindi_medium.definition: Content, questions or tests are only in English; users ask for Hindi-medium support.

class_language.name: Live classes only in Hindi
class_language.definition: Live or recorded classes are taught in a language the user cannot follow.

app_crash.name: App crashes or won't open
app_crash.definition: App crashes, does not open, stops working, or does not run on the user's device.
app_crash.excludes: Lag or slowness while the app is running (app_glitches).

app_glitches.name: Glitches, lag and repeated loading
app_glitches.definition: App lags, hangs, reloads screens repeatedly, or buttons misbehave, but still opens.

eval_fails.name: Answer evaluation fails
eval_fails.definition: Mains answer evaluation errors out or cannot be completed.

progress_not_saved.name: Progress not saved
progress_not_saved.definition: Completed units, streaks or history show as incomplete or are lost.

loses_place.name: App restarts when switching apps
loses_place.definition: Leaving the app briefly sends the user back to the start instead of where they were.

sound_not_mutable.name: Answer sounds can't be muted
sound_not_mutable.definition: Sounds play on answers with no way to turn them off, interrupting the user's own audio.

feature_hard_to_find.name: Features hard to find in the app
feature_hard_to_find.definition: User cannot find a feature that exists (e.g. AI doubt solving) in the app.

ipad_layout.name: iPad shows the phone layout
ipad_layout.definition: App is not optimised for iPad or large screens: phone layout, no full screen, no landscape. Includes requests for an iPad version.

dark_mode.name: Dark mode missing or broken
dark_mode.definition: No dark mode, or the dark mode option does not work.

web_parity.name: Features missing on web or app
web_parity.definition: A feature or material is available on one of web or app but not the other, or the user is forced onto the phone.
web_parity.excludes: Asking for a native desktop or Windows app (desktop_app).

paywall_limits.name: Free limits and paywalled features
paywall_limits.definition: Daily limits are too low, or features that were free now need a paid plan. Includes asks to raise limits.
paywall_limits.excludes: The overall price being too high (too_expensive).

too_expensive.name: Plans are too expensive
too_expensive.definition: The paid plan's price is too high or poor value for the content.

billing_issues.name: Autopay and card-saving at checkout
billing_issues.definition: Unexpected auto-debit, forced card saving, wrong charges or refund problems.

misleading_ads.name: Ads don't match the product
misleading_ads.definition: Ads or promotions promise something (e.g. free access) the product does not deliver.

not_informed.name: Changes not communicated
not_informed.definition: Paying users are not told about updates, schedule changes or new material.

content_sourcing.name: Content seen as copied from other sources
content_sourcing.definition: Concern that content is rephrased from NCERT, newspapers or others without credit.

support_unresolved.name: Support didn't resolve the issue
support_unresolved.definition: User contacted support and got no response or no resolution, or cannot find a way to get help.

content_errors.name: Incomplete or wrong content
content_errors.definition: Study material has incomplete sentences, errors or gaps inside existing lessons.

content_gaps.name: Subjects or depth missing
content_gaps.definition: Whole subjects, Mains depth or topics are missing; the product feels basic.

news_gaps.name: Current affairs skip stories
news_gaps.definition: Daily news coverage leaves out stories the user considers important.

ai_off_syllabus.name: AI-generated MCQs go off-syllabus
ai_off_syllabus.definition: Generated questions fall outside the UPSC syllabus or the requested topic.

eval_unfair.name: Evaluation marks seem inconsistent
eval_unfair.definition: The same answer gets different marks, or marking seems biased or wrong.

too_much_ai.name: Too much reliance on AI
too_much_ai.definition: User dislikes how much of the product is AI-driven.

desktop_app.name: Desktop or Windows app
desktop_app.definition: Asks for a native desktop, laptop or Windows app.

bookmarks_ca.name: Bookmarks in current affairs
bookmarks_ca.definition: Asks to bookmark or save current-affairs articles.

ai_search_ca.name: AI search in current affairs
ai_search_ca.definition: Asks for search inside the current-affairs section.

listen_audio.name: Listen to articles as audio
listen_audio.definition: Asks for a read-aloud or audio option for articles.

downloadable_material.name: Downloadable study material
downloadable_material.definition: Asks to download notes or material for offline use.

issue_reporting.name: In-app way to report issues
issue_reporting.definition: Asks for a feedback or bug-report option inside the app.

ca_mcq_subjects.name: More subjects in current-affairs MCQs
ca_mcq_subjects.definition: Asks for wider subject coverage in current-affairs questions.

optional_subjects.name: Optional subjects, such as Law
optional_subjects.definition: Asks for UPSC optional-subject content or guidance.

mnemonics.name: Mnemonics for each subject
mnemonics.definition: Asks for memory aids per subject.

daily_quizzes.name: Quizzes on every day of the week
daily_quizzes.definition: Asks for quizzes on days they are not offered, such as Sundays.

test_formats.name: More test formats, checked by a person
test_formats.definition: Asks for sectional or full-length timed tests, or human-checked papers.

other_exams.name: Other exams (SSC JE, State PSC)
other_exams.definition: Asks SuperKalam to cover exams other than UPSC CSE.

more_questions.name: More practice questions
more_questions.definition: Asks for more questions per topic or test.

eval_quality.name: Evaluation feels like an experienced evaluator
eval_quality.definition: Praises the quality, accuracy or usefulness of Mains answer evaluation and model answers.

eval_speed.name: Mains feedback in seconds, not weeks
eval_speed.definition: Praises how fast answer evaluation is.

mcq_quality.name: Questions at the real exam level
mcq_quality.definition: Praises MCQs, their level, explanations, CSAT or topic-wise practice.

pyq_practice.name: Previous-year questions in one place
pyq_practice.definition: Praises PYQ practice for Prelims or Mains.

current_affairs.name: Current affairs and news analysis
current_affairs.definition: Praises daily news, current-affairs analysis, quizzes or the monthly magazine.

study_modules.name: Clear, structured study content
study_modules.definition: Praises lessons, modules, notes, NCERT coverage or concept clarity.

daily_targets.name: Daily targets and streaks build discipline
daily_targets.definition: Praises daily targets, streaks, reminders, study plans or consistency.

progress_tracking.name: Weak areas and progress tracking
progress_tracking.definition: Praises progress tracking, weekly reports, weak-area detection or analytics.

ai_doubts.name: Doubts answered instantly by AI
ai_doubts.definition: Praises the AI chat, AI mentor or instant doubt solving.

affordable.name: Affordable compared with coaching
affordable.definition: Praises the price, free access or value for money.

easy_ui.name: Clean, easy interface
easy_ui.definition: Praises the UI, design, smoothness or ease of use.

all_in_one.name: Everything in one place
all_in_one.definition: Praises having all preparation resources in one app.

mentors.name: Supportive mentors and classes
mentors.definition: Praises mentors, teachers or live classes.

responsive_team.name: Responsive, helpful team
responsive_team.definition: Praises support staff or the team acting on feedback.

segments.other_exams: State PSC and other exam aspirants
